what: Per-phase output filenames in the plan do not match dispatch-with-waterfall.sh naming
scenario_or_breakage: Following the plan can make phase artifacts and tests look for aggregator-output.txt.phase3 while the dispatcher writes a different path such as aggregator-output.txt.phase3-phase3 or aggregator-output-phase3.txt
suggested_fix: Drive candidate selection from ALL_OUTPUT_FILES and either use the dispatcher's existing output_for_phase names or explicitly copy/rename phase outputs to the documented .phaseN paths after dispatch

what: Plan says any validator failure triggers the 3-phase waterfall but also says existing validation-failed tests continue unchanged
scenario_or_breakage: Existing malformed or dropped-reviewer fixtures that currently expect REASON=validation-failed will become validation-exhausted after three identical stub outputs, causing test failures or forcing hidden special cases
suggested_fix: Choose one contract: preferably retry only the new zero-block structural-loss validation failure for minimal scope, or update every existing validation-failure test and docs to expect waterfall exhaustion

what: The review-core short-circuit is underspecified compared with the panel-failed branch it says to mirror
scenario_or_breakage: An implementation may emit only counts and status, leaving accepted/rejected/OOS files, round log flushing, and file-path KVs absent; downstream wrappers default paths but run artifacts can be incomplete during a stall
suggested_fix: Copy the panel-failed short-circuit shape concretely: truncate/create accepted-findings.md rejected-findings.md and oos-accepted-review.md, emit ROUND_NUM file-path KVs PANEL_MODE PANEL_SHAPE OUT_OF_SCOPE_DRIFT_COUNT, and flush/copy the same observability artifacts before exit
